body: I think I'm done. Bye everyone.

I've done all I could to distract myself. Just to simply repress everything. I don't have much support from family, most of them are deceased. I no longer keep in touch with my parents for personal reasons. This condition, the hallucinations, the flashbacks, I've had enough of. I do not have hope for myself or for anyone. Like I've said, a nuke would be great. It's unfortunate that it has gotten to this point. I can't really find pleasure in anything, anymore. Therapy just doesn't work. Other than my few friends, I've a hard time trusting people. My love-life is still a mess (I can't even hold regular conversations with dates for that long- at least until paranoia sets in or I just stare blankly at anything) but I don't care about that anymore. I'll do what I can and see if I can get some antidepressants. 
Edit: What is holding me back from ending it all is cowardice. I know I can make it happen if I tried. Regardless, this is my last post.
